parsedVerdict.reasoning: The file sorts known domain and application errors into categories that don't depend on any transport: 'not_found', 'validation' and 'conflict'. Adapters can then report these errors without knowing their concrete types. This is an application-layer job: it describes the outcomes of use cases as errors. It doesn't map errors to HTTP status codes, build responses, use framework types or touch persistence. Turning these categories into transport-specific responses is left to the infrastructure middleware (ErrorHandlerMiddleware), which imports this file. The file holds no misplaced business rules or infrastructure logic.
